personality: Fusion: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK structural surfaces + 7 Dark-First Utility DARK for data density and typography.
personality_one_liner: A high-end, stop-scroll enterprise pricing command center combining rugged automotive undertones with luxury glassmorphism and aggressive condensed typography.

spacing.rule: Use strict 8pt grid. Generous outer margins (24px) for mobile, clamping at max-width 900px for desktop-web centering. Dense padding inside price cards (12px) to maximize data visibility.

do's: Use heavy tinted glass (>= 80% opacity of surfaceSecondary) for sticky search headers and bottom action bars.
Apply glass effects on the Login form card over the hero background.
Use blur behind the 'recent searches' dropdown or sticky filters.
dont's: Never use glass on the dense product pricing cards themselves (use solid surfaceSecondary to maintain data readability).
Do not blur standard inputs or body content.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Premium authenticated entry point that sets the brand's luxury automotive tone.

states.loading: Spinner overlaid on the login button; fields disabled.
states.error: Soft red warning banner above the inputs (e.g., 'Credenciales incorrectas').

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image background (dark rugged tire). A vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 90% surface base) sits behind a glassmorphic login card. Centered layout on desktop (max-width: 400px card). Brand logo at the top. Large, 56pt high inputs. Primary CTA is brandPrimary (crimson) with a subtle vertical gradient. Spanish labels.

screens.name: Search Home
screens.purpose: The main command center for fast, typo-tolerant SKU/Marca lookups.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the 'recent searches' list.
states.empty: No recent searches: subtle Phosphor search icon + 'No hay búsquedas recientes'.

screens.layout: Desktop-optimized: Content centered with a max-width of 800px. A massive, prominent search bar (56pt height, 20pt text) dominates the top area. Below, a compact section for 'Últimas 6 búsquedas' rendered as pill chips. Actions: A 'Refresh' button (Master sync shortcut) and a placeholder 'Consultar inventario' button for Phase 2.

screens.name: Product Result
screens.purpose: Displays authorized pricing data instantly and clearly based on the user's role.

states.loading: Card skeletons showing the structure of SKU and price rows.
states.empty: Premium empty state: Large Phosphor Box icon, 'No se encontraron neumáticos', and a 'Nueva consulta' button.
states.error: 'No disponible' state for missing prices within the card layout itself.

screens.layout: Desktop-optimized: Multi-column grid (2-col or 3-col depending on screen width) for product cards. Mobile: Single column. Each card is solid surfaceSecondary with borderStrong. Layout inside card: Header with SKU (Bebas Neue) and MARCA. Body with DESCRIPCIÓN and RIN. Bottom half dedicated to Price columns (Precio 1/2/3). Sticky bottom bar containing 'Buscar otro' and 'Nueva consulta' primary actions, using glassmorphism.

screens.name: Master Panel
screens.purpose: Admin dashboard for managing data sync and viewing global query stats.

states.loading: Full screen centered spinner during manual data refresh.
states.error: Sync failed banner with exact Excel parsing error + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sidebar navigation on desktop, stack on mobile. Top section: Last sync timestamp (large display type) and a massive 'Actualizar Datos' button (brandSecondary orange). Middle section: Stat cards showing 'Últimas 6 búsquedas globales'. Bottom: Recent activity logs. Strong separation of admin controls from regular user search.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The target environment includes desktop web (react-native-web). At the root of the Search Home, Product Result, and Master Panel screens, implement a centering wrapper with a max-width (e.g., 900px) and width: '100%'. Use Flexbox wrap for the Product Results cards so they form a multi-column grid on desktop.

Typography Rule: Use the requested BebasNeue font for headings (SKU names, app titles, sync stats) and Inter for all body content, labels, and price numbers. Do not use @expo-google-fonts; assume fonts will be loaded locally via expo-font from assets.

Brand Colors: Ensure all gradients strictly use the brandPrimary (#E11D2A) to brandSecondary (#E0552F) spectrum. Do not mix unrelated hues. Use the dark surface colors (#0C0C10 base, #15161C cards) to create the 'stop-scroll' luxury contrast.
Visual Hierarchy: The Search Bar on 'Search Home' must be oversized (minimum 56px height) to indicate it is the primary interaction point. Use large touch targets globally.

Data Privacy: The Product Result screen must dynamically hide price rows based on the user's role. If a price is null/missing, explicitly render an elegant 'No disponible' text instead of an empty space.
Use a strict vertical gradient scrim on the Login screen behind the login form to ensure perfect text readability against the dark tire background image.
